Les nombres anglais sont très réguliers: English numbers are very regular: twenty-one, twenty-two… Trap no. 1 is the **-teen / -ty** pair: thir**teen** (13) ≠ thir**ty** (30). The stress falls at the end for -teen, at the start for -ty.

Les grands nombres s’écrivent avec une *: Large numbers are written with a **comma** (1,000) and decimals with a **point** (2.5) — the opposite of French!

**Centaines :** a / one hundred, two hun: **Hundreds:** a / one hundred, two hundred and ten. **Thousands:** a thousand, twenty thousand. **Million:** a million, three million. Years are read in pairs: 1999 = **nineteen ninety-nine**, 2025 = **twenty twenty-five**.
